witness_statement.statement_under_section: Section 161 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973
witness_statement.statement_text: My name is Ramesh Chand and I live at B-143, next door to B-142 where Meena Devi Sharma resides with her daughter. I have known the Sharma family for over 10 years. On the night of 5th December 2024, I was at home as usual. At around 9:15 PM, I went to my balcony on the first floor to have a cup of tea. From the balcony, I have partial view of the back portion of the B-142 house. I noticed a man walking in the back lane and then climbing over the boundary wall of B-142 house. It was dark but the streetlight from the corner helped me see reasonably well. The man was wearing dark clothes and looked like Sanjay Sharma, the younger brother of late Suresh Sharma. I could recognize him because Sanjay used to visit the family often and I have met him multiple times. I thought it was strange that he was entering through the back instead of the front door, but I did not want to interfere in their family matters. At around 9:30 PM, I heard raised voices from the direction of the B-142 house. It sounded like an argument between a man and a woman. The voices were muffled but I could clearly make out that it was Meena Devi and Sanjay arguing. I could hear Sanjay's raised voice mentioning something about 'property' and 'Sonipat' and 'my share'. This went on for about 10-15 minutes. Then at around 9:45 PM, I heard a loud scream - it was a woman's voice. It was a very frightening scream. I rushed to my balcony and looked towards the B-142 house but I could not see anything clearly. After about 10 minutes of silence, I heard footsteps in the back lane again. At around 10:00 PM, I saw the same man - Sanjay Sharma - leaving through the side gate of the house. He was walking fast and I noticed he was carrying something wrapped in cloth. He looked agitated. I did not know what to do at that time. I thought of calling Meena Devi but did not have her mobile number. I did not want to interfere. I deeply regret now that I did not act on my suspicions. In the morning when I heard the news, I was shocked. I am giving this statement to the police with full truth. I can identify Sanjay Sharma if shown to me. I can also confirm that the voices I heard were definitely Meena Devi's and Sanjay Sharma's.

identification_of_accused.identification_details: Sanjay Sharma - neighbor's brother-in-law, well known personally. Wearing dark colored clothes on the night of incident.
